title: Maneki-Neko, 2 dollars

specs.Decoration: digital printing, laser frosting, 24-karat gold plating

descriptionPlain: Description In Japanese folklore, the Maneki-Neko is a symbol of protection and good fortune. According to legend, an ordinary cat once saved a samurai by beckoning him into a temple just moments before lightning struck the place where he had stood. That single gesture became a sign of gratitude, courage, and luck. This silver coin reinterprets the story through dynamic comic-style panels, unfolding the peaceful appearance of the smiling Maneki-Neko. The design blends traditional symbolism with a modern visual narrative, turning the coin into a talisman that carries a message of safety and good fortune.
